messages:
mina: Heads up — onbringup for equinox-v1 (int8) shows a weird token collapse on mixed CJK+Latin neologisms, causing zh->en BLEU to drop ~6 points :worried:
ashwin: can you paste a minimal repro?
mina: yep, simple example from our devset:
mina: `开放AIry 计划`
mina: baseline tokenization (fp16):
```
['开放AIry', ' ', '计划']
```
mina: int8 quantized run tokenization (problem):
```
['开放', 'AI', 'ry', ' ', '计划']
```
mina: translation diffs: baseline -> "OpenAIry program", int8 -> "Open AI ry program" (broken brand concat). Also many samplings produce spurious spaces in mixed segments.
eva-bot: smoke run summary for equinox-v1:int8-nightly:
- p95 latency: 44ms
- throughput: 118k toks/s
- zh->en BLEU delta vs fp16 baseline: -6.2
- repro cases in smoke: 92/500
kai: that split looks like subword merge rules changed — maybe the tokenizer library started treating ASCII sequences as separate segments when adjacent to wide chars. Any tokenizer config diffs?
mina: checked: tokenizer.json shows "merge_rule": "aggresive_mixedscript_fix": false in 2.4.0; baseline had it true in 2.3.1
ashwin: ah, so tokenizer-lib bumped and default changed. Was that noticed in onboarding?
julia: we only validated on clean corpora, not many neologisms/brand names. I can add a small targeted eval set.
kai: also check ZWJ/ZWSP handling — those often change merge boundaries. Could be kernel-level normalization in quant path.
ashwin: quick bisect: tokenizer-lib 2.3.1 -> 2.4.0 included changeset 0c9f2a (mixedscript heuristics). Will open GH issue referencing the exact diff.
mina: attaching a few more failing examples:
- "赤坂MetaX研讨" -> fp16: "Akasaka MetaX symposium"; int8: "Akasaka Meta X symposium"
- "新潮Xperia发布" -> fp16: "ShinchaoXperia release"; int8: "Shinchao Xperia release"
mina: these are frequent in social-media-style inputs where brands/neologisms are concatenated with CJK.
ops-bot: canary request queued.
julia: rolling a canary with tokenizer-lib pinned to 2.3.1 + equinox-v1:int8 binary (canary-crypto) to validate behavior.
ops-bot: Canary deployed to staging (canary-7) at 4123456792 :rocket:
mina: rough mitigation idea: fallback to concat-merge for ASCII runs when adjacent to Han/Kana/Hangul, i.e. treat ASCII+letters as a single token block before subwording.
kai: we should be careful — that could increase vocab collisions; but as a targeted heuristic it might be fine. Also confirm whether quantization changed the tokenization runtime path (i.e., different code path for speed).
ashwin: I ran a microprofile: int8 path uses a different C++ tokenizer shim (fast-tokenizer v2) which had new normalization steps. That explains diffs even without explicit config changes.
julia: steps: 1) add 1k neologism brand+mixedscript cases to nightly eval; 2) run canary with old tokenizer pin; 3) if passes, patch fast-tokenizer to match prior normalization rule; 4) consider heuristic fallback. Scheduling re-run tonight.
mina: thanks — I'll add the eval cases and a script to synthesize brand-like tokens (random ascii + kanji combos).
eva-bot: scheduled targeted eval 4123456800 (estimated finish 6h).
mina: created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tokenizer-lib/issues/348 (added examples + perf diffs).
ashwin: pinging infra to hold broad rollout until we confirm. @ops-bot can you block autoscale updates for equinox-v1 in prod?
ops-bot: Autoscale updates for equinox-v1 paused for 2h.
julia: will watch the eval. If old tokenizer pin fixes BLEU, we can either pin or backport the normalization change with a regression test.
mina: one more note — sampling quality also degrades: models tend to insert spaces and produce extra short tokens which harm both deterministic and stochastic decodes.
kai: good catch. Might be subtle interaction between KV cache alignment and token boundaries in tiled kernels. I'll take a look at the kernel shim diffs.
mina: thanks everyone. Leaving the thread open until results. :thumbsup:
